steps.title: Prepare frozen tissue sections
steps.instruction: Embed fresh frozen tissue in OCT compound, store at -80 °C, cryosection at 10 µm, collect on Superfrost slides and keep at -80 °C until fixation.

steps.title: Thaw slides and fix tissue
steps.instruction: Remove slides from -80 °C, let stand at room temperature for 3 min to air‑dry, then apply freshly prepared 3 % (w/v) paraformaldehyde in DEPC‑PBS directly onto the section for 5 min at RT (handle PFA with safety precautions).

substeps.instruction: Fix with 3 % PFA in DEPC‑PBS for 5 min at RT

steps.title: Permeabilize with HCl
steps.instruction: Dip each slide in ~20 mL of 0.1 M HCl (in H₂O) at RT for 5 min (use HCl safety precautions).

steps.title: Wash post-permeabilization
steps.instruction: Wash slides in DEPC‑PBS for 1 min at RT, then rinse the slide two additional times with DEPC‑PBS.

steps.title: Ethanol dehydration series
steps.instruction: Immerse slides sequentially in 70 % EtOH for 1 min at RT, then in 100 % EtOH for 1 min at RT; air‑dry afterwards.

steps.title: Mount hybridization chamber
steps.instruction: When dry, place a SecureSeal hybridization chamber over the tissue, using a chamber size that fully covers the region of interest.

steps.title: Rehydrate tissue
steps.instruction: Rehydrate sections by adding DEPC‑PBS‑T, then rinse once with DEPC‑PBS (see Note 11).

steps.title: Wash with PBS-T
steps.instruction: Wash the sections twice with DEPC‑PBS‑T.

steps.title: Post-RCA washes
steps.instruction: After rolling circle amplification, wash samples twice with DEPC‑PBS‑T while keeping slides protected from light.

steps.title: Ethanol wash before imaging
steps.instruction: Dip slides in 70 % EtOH for 1 min, remove the SecureSeal chamber, dip in 100 % EtOH for 1 min, then air‑dry the slides.

steps.title: Mount coverslip
steps.instruction: Apply ~10 µL of mounting medium (e.g., SlowFade) onto the tissue and place a coverslip; store slides in the dark at +4 °C for long‑term storage before imaging.

steps.title: Set up microscope
steps.instruction: Use a standard epifluorescence microscope with a 20× objective; employ DAPI staining to locate the section and visualize RCA products.

steps.title: Acquire image stacks
steps.instruction: Capture images at multiple focal depths using reference points for sequential base imaging; merge the stacks into a single image via maximum‑intensity projection.

steps.title: Strip fluorophores after imaging
steps.instruction: After each base‑imaging round, remove the coverslip by dipping the slide in 70 % EtOH until it releases (or in PBS for subsequent rounds if a hydrophobic pen is used), then dip in 100 % EtOH for 1 min and air‑dry.

steps.title: Apply hydrophobic barrier
steps.instruction: Draw a hydrophobic‑pen barrier around the tissue section, or alternatively mount another SecureSeal chamber.

steps.title: Formamide washes
steps.instruction: Wash sections with 100 % formamide at RT for 3 min; repeat this wash two additional times for a total of three 3‑minute washes.

steps.title: Repeat base-specific cycles
steps.instruction: Repeat the imaging, stripping, and formamide‑wash cycles for each additional base as required; if using a hydrophobic pen, omit the chamber and apply solutions directly onto the section.
